g.text: Peak GPU memory, trainer vs inference engine

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #52514e

g.text: GPU roles are inferred: the engine's GPUs are the ones with the highest median memory (KV cache preallocated), so their peak is the engine's memory setting, not a need. nvidia-smi includes the allocator's cache.
